risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively detailed and quantified, but contains substantial standard forward-looking disclaimers and aspirational targets. Operating risk is evident from a 12% volume decline, lower demand, supply-chain and commodity pressures, and a sharp reduction in Tools & Outdoor segment margin. Cost reductions, divestiture proceeds, and debt reduction provide mitigation, though execution and leverage-related risks remain material.
